class.documentation: A Vocabulary is a set of representations of concepts (terms and definitions) for the language of a particular speech community that is expressed in a specified natural language. A speech community may create a vocabulary by importing a one or more existing vocabulary and overriding selected terms, adding terms for new concepts and (implicitly) incorporating the remaining terms and definitions of the existing vocabulary. This mechanism may be employed to introduce synonyms as the primary terms of the specializing community. Both vocabularies should be in the same natural language so that definitions remain meaningful.
